desc:
🧬 Welcome to +1 Mutation Evolution 🧬

Start as a NOOB and turn your arms into living weapons!

Use code "Thanks" to get cool rewards!💥

🧬 Absorb enemies to grow stronger!
🦾 Collect DNA to unlock and upgrade claws, giant fists, blades and tentacles!
⚔️ Fight waves of enemies and defeat powerful bosses!
🏆 Clear stages and collect Wins!
🔄 Evolve to become even stronger!
🌍 Unlock new worlds and face tougher challenges!

How powerful can your mutant become? 💥

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite the game to support future updates!
